about.title: About
about.description: I build   systems that make complex products simpler to build, operate, and evolve. I am a product-focused full stack engineer based in Bangalore, India, with experience designing and delivering production systems across enterprise platforms, fintech, logistics, AI-enabled applications, and custom business software. My work spans reusable frontend platforms, real-time systems, data-driven dashboards, AI-powered product experiences, and end-to-end application development. I enjoy taking ambiguous business problems, turning them into clear system boundaries and usable products, and owning the engineering from architecture through deployment.

technical_approach.title: TECHNICAL APPROACH
technical_approach.description: I focus on building reusable systems rather than repeatedly solving the same problem. My work spans config-driven architectures, full-stack product development, real-time systems, AI-integrated interfaces, API design, and data-driven applications. I care about finding the right abstraction, keeping system boundaries clear, and balancing engineering quality with business impact.
